strictAdmission.currencyMultiplier: Original GLSPlatformParser uses parseInt(node.textContent,10) if present, else source-defined1. This helper requires a present valid node in same actual Init; no missing-node default is admitted.
strictAdmission.selection: Explicit actual paid totalStake/paylineCount must match parsed same-Init Stakes matrix. Native defaults are diagnostics, never paid choice authorization.
strictAdmission.headers: Ordinary non-promo only: caller must explicitly bind promoInfo===null and freeRoundInfo===null; non-null holds and keeps source FR-Info leaf as proof.
strictAdmission.history: Actual original util.URL queryData semantics, not URLSearchParams decoding. HistoryServerURL!==null/undefined stays hold.
strictAdmission.originalAOwnership: A binds actual launch/meta/session/paid intent/Init/response/money/token and original transport/ACK. No fake response/end/owner is created.
